answer: Agents arranging a river voyage for jade shipments must each lock a separate bond for 90 days before bidding for work. The registry grants one bidding slot per bond and keeps that bond locked even if its agent leaves early. An attacker can still create fake agents, but gaining 1,000 slots requires funding 1,000 bonds at once; recycling the same funds through new identities cannot bypass the lock, making a sybil swarm costly in tied-up capital.
